headline: Bank of Korea Reports Rise in October 2026 Deposit and Loan Rates
summary: The Bank of Korea reported that the average interest rate on new deposits rose 17 basis points to 3.62% in October 2026, while the average interest rate on new loans increased 7 basis points to 4.64%.
why: Central bank statistical releases provide vital data on monetary transmission and banking sector funding costs, guiding institutional investors on credit conditions.

impacts.name: South Korea Deposit Rate
impacts.why: The central bank data directly reports the increase in new deposit and loan interest rates.
